maya: Quick heads-up 1: All-hands tomorrow 10:00 PT. Compact agenda, 25 minutes. Drop Qs here or in the doc.

maya: Agenda (25m):
- 10:00-10:05 Exec update  strategy & hiring priorities (CEO)
- 10:05-10:12 Product highlight  Dedicated autoscale demo + perf numbers
- 10:12-10:18 Policy update  default retention + ops runbook tweak
- 10:18-10:25 Live Q&A (we'll pull top upvoted Qs)

maya: Q&A doc: https://docs.google.com/redwood-allhands-qna-1845 (please add and upvote)

arjun: Runbook note: added a preflight node-health check and auto-escalation to oncall+SRE lead after 3 retry attempts. Will paste exact runbook diff in the doc.

leah: Ops policy change: default debug-index retention will be 120 days starting next week. Teams can override per-project in Settings > Data Retention. Migration help added to the Q&A doc.

leah: Export snippet I added: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports -d '{"project":"myproj","from":"-120d"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'```

jon: Managers: submit any headcount asks to the hiring tracker by EOD today; we'll surface top requests in the last 2 minutes.

kate: APAC follow-up: slides + recording posted immediately; office hours 16:00 SGT for region Qs.

all-hands-bot: Calendar reminder posted: All-hands  Strategy + Product + Policy  Tomorrow 10:00 PT.

recording-bot: Recording will be uploaded at https://records.redwood.co/meetings/1845123456 when the meeting ends (slides: https://slides.redwood.co/allhands/1845123456).

maya: Post-meeting summary (short):
- Exec: focus on reliability and platform SLA improvements; hiring approved for +4 infra & +2 product roles.
- Product: autoscale demo shows ~15% reduction in 95/99 tail latency on internal traces with no change to median.
- Policy: default retention move to 120 days; opt-out path documented; migration guide live in the Q&A doc.
- Ops: runbook escalation and healthchecks deployed; added weekly smoke tests.

maya: If we missed questions from the doc, we'll reply here and update the public notes. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
